emailMkt.lead: Connect an email sending platform to run campaigns & automation. Pick a provider below.

sub.smtp: Send through your business mail server (port 465 / 587, TLS required)

emailMkt.needManage: Managing integrations is required to connect or change provider. You can still pick a configured sender when creating a campaign.

1.d: Brevo › SMTP & API › API keys › Generate a new API key.

2.d: Brevo › Senders & IP › add the sender address and confirm the email (status Active).

3.d: Add the DKIM / SPF / DMARC records Brevo provides to your domain DNS, then click Authenticate in Brevo.

4.d: Click Connect, paste the API key, the sender email and (optional) a webhook token of at least 16 characters.

5.d: Brevo › Webhooks › add AppChat's callback URL with Bearer token = the webhook token you entered to receive delivered / opened / bounce events.

1.d: SMTP host name, port 465 (TLS) or 587 (STARTTLS) — port 25 / unencrypted is not supported.

2.d: Google Workspace / Gmail: turn on 2-step verification, then create an app password for AppChat.

3.d: Click Connect, enter host, port, account, password and sender address.

4.d: Set "Sender confirmed" when this address truly belongs to the business — SMTP login does not prove domain ownership.

5.d: AppChat probes the connection (no email sent). SMTP has no delivered / opened / clicked events — reports say "not supported".

emailMkt.noSender: No sender yet — connect a provider above.
emailMkt.noteBrevo: AppChat receives delivered / opened / clicked / bounce status from Brevo through the authenticated webhook for Marketing reports. Customer replies go to the reply-to address — to read them in AppChat, connect the Email channel in Inbox.
emailMkt.noteSmtp: SMTP only confirms the server accepted the email — no delivered / opened / clicked data. Customer replies do not come back to AppChat; connect the Email channel in Inbox if you need to read replies.
